privileged_info_for_vlm: The Nx Witness VMS is accessible at https://localhost:7001. The agent must use the token in /home/ga/nx_token.txt or the credentials admin/Admin1234!. The environment contains synthetic data where specific cameras have recording disabled and specific users have no layouts. The final report must be a JSON file located at /home/ga/coverage_gap_report.json and must include the 'gaps' and 'summary' objects as defined in the task description.
